headline: Amri Syahnawi And Nita Violina Marwah Eliminated In Hong Kong Open
seoTitle: Amri Syahnawi, Nita Violina Exit Hong Kong Open
metaDescription: Indonesian mixed doubles pair Amri Syahnawi and Nita Violina Marwah were eliminated during the round of 16 at the 2026 Hong Kong Open tournament.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian mixed doubles pair failed to progress to the quarter-finals of the 2026 Hong Kong Open.
Amri Syahnawi and Nita Violina Marwah were defeated by representatives from Chinese Taipei.
The match results conclude the pair's competitive participation in the 2026 tournament calendar.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian badminton mixed doubles duo, Amri Syahnawi and Nita Violina Marwah, concluded their campaign at the 2026 Hong Kong Open following a defeat in the round of 16. The pair faced opponents Wu Hsuan-Yi and Yang Chu Yun from Chinese Taipei. Prior to their elimination, the Indonesian representatives had navigated through the earlier stages of the competition, which included a dramatic victory in the opening game. This tournament marked the final event for the pair in the 2026 season. The outcome represents the end of their progression in the tournament bracket, as they were unable to advance to the quarter-final round. The event was documented by regional sports media outlets as the conclusion of the duo's competitive output for the current year.
whyItIsViral: The event is being tracked by three independent news outlets with a moderate pace of coverage reporting on the conclusion of the pair's 2026 season.
